authority: Original literal requirements; no denominator or acceptance text changes.

requirements.title: Source Capability Model
requirements.literal_contract: Every source declares the seven capabilities and its collection strategy; unsupported capabilities remain explicit. The requirement lists eight strategy families without requiring every family to be implemented.
backends: SQLite import, persistence, reopen and API readback
Four isolated PostgreSQL aliases in protected integration
Connected native Chromium API/UI, disable, reload and mobile layout
caveats: Capability declarations do not authorize scheduling, enable disabled sources, imply source health, or enable external submissions.
WWR preserves salary=false. Valid persisted extension declarations are read without invoking factories.
The local mock-ATS source is explicitly labeled as a fixture; no real employer submission is claimed.

requirements.title: Error Categories
assertions: Durable recovery metadata and terminal audit
Fresh Store reopen, operation detail and profile progress API
Profile isolation and no private-canary disclosure
Existing source retry policy retained; no new automatic application retries
Fenced receipt recovery accepts exact historical/current proof shapes and rejects mixed, extra or mismatched evidence
backends: Isolated PostgreSQL subclass in protected integration
caveats: An unmapped or ambiguous diagnostic remains unclassified; enum membership is not evidence of an invented cause.
Synthetic provider failures and local browser fixtures establish error behavior without paid inference or employer submission.
